description: This file defines the CKEDITOR.dom.event class, which wraps native DOM event objects and provides methods to access event properties, prevent default behavior, stop propagation, and retrieve event targets. It also defines constants for modifier keys.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.dom.event
classes.description: Represents a native DOM event object, providing methods to interact with and control DOM events.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the key code associated with the event.

methods.name: getKeystroke
methods.description: Returns a number representing the combination of keys pressed during the event, including modifier keys.

methods.name: preventDefault
methods.description: Prevents the default action of the event and optionally stops propagation.

methods.name: stopPropagation
methods.description: Stops the event from propagating further.

methods.name: getTarget
methods.description: Returns the DOM node where the event was targeted.
